Django announced on October 8, 2026 that it no longer accepts new security reports through HackerOne. Existing HackerOne reports remain open; new reports go to security@djangoproject.com under the official Django security policy. Historical directory and bounty flags below do not establish current HackerOne submission availability. This does not establish reward eligibility or a new asset-scope table.
